lena: thanks — documenting in release notes: note about redis maxclients and module pin to v1.12.4. will open follow-up item for perf tests.

marie: +1. adding a short note in infra release doc and the post-deploy checklist.

raj: nice work. leave the routing hold for +10m then remove once stable. :thumbsup:
